entities.summary: Kofi Amoakohene is a Ghanaian politician and member of the Seventh Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the Atebubu-Amantin Constituency in the Bono East Region on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party. He was the former Bono East Regional Minister.
